title: Affine space commutes with change of coefficient ring
statement: For any commutative rings k and A with an algebra k -> A and any variable type I, the square of spectra of A[I], k[I], A and k induced by coefficient change and constant inclusion is cartesian. The two maps out of Spec A[I] are exactly Spec(map(k -> A)) and Spec(C:A -> A[I]). Polynomial rings and pullbacks use [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] and [def-pc-base-change].

proof.text: The tensor product A tensor_k k[I] is the pushout of A and k[I] over k. Its canonical polynomial algebra equivalence with A[I] sends a tensor 1 to C(a), and 1 tensor p to coefficient change of p. Transport the pushout square through this equivalence and apply Spec to obtain the stated pullback square.

theorem isPullback_bertiniAffineAmbient
    (k A : Type u) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (I : Type u) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.map
        (σ := I) (algebraMap k A))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial I A)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* MvPolynomial I k)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
